correctness.rationale: PASS: For a fixed configuration a disagreement across a rung forces both horizontal neighbors to match each endpoint, propagating an oriented mismatch across every rung, impossible across the swapped Möbius seam; fixed points are cyclic binary words without isolated bits. Their four-state adjacent-pair transfer gives the Lucas-plus-period-six trace Q_n. For recurrence, the standard symmetric-graph parallel-majority theorem bounds periods by two. The paired-time four-bit-column local rule is encoded as a 256-state transfer with row-swap S at the seam, hence P_n=tr(T^n S). Independently regenerated all allowable 256-state transitions, computed cyclic SCC sizes 16,8,8,2,1,1 and the invariant component characteristic polynomial; the swap excludes the exchanged components. The characteristic factors and sign twist imply the displayed all-n formulas. Independently applied majority directly to every labelled configuration for 3<=n<=9 and confirmed all Q_n,P_n, including n=4 Q=6,P=48 and n=9 Q=74,P=5476. Exact finite-matrix algebra and the period-two theorem—not finite width extrapolation—support the unbounded n classification.
